text:
Maya: Opening a small PR to update rate-limit examples and the Grafana panel for tiered metering.

Alex: Confirm metric rename? consumption_total -> usage_tokens_total?

Maya: Yes. We'll document a 60-day alias for consumption_total and include both queries in examples.

Priya: Found two broken doc links to dashboards; internal panel IDs changed. Validated Grafana query: 
sum by (customer_tier) (increase(usage_tokens_total{env="prod"}[5m]))

Tao: FYI ingestion switched the label from "tier" -> "customer_tier" on 2026-02-12. Add a tiny HOWTO to replace the label in saved panel JSON and re-save. Also note burst credits are applied server-side and affect visible quota numbers.

Alex: Recommend standardizing the client header to "x-rw-sdk". Add examples for response headers "x-rw-quota-remaining" and "x-rw-burst-credit" so UIs can show accurate remaining quota.

deploy-bot: Maya opened PR #2456: docs: rate/quotas + grafana panel migration https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2456

Maya: Thanks; I'll merge after CI and post a short note in #announcements tagging dashboard owners.
